title: Liver microbiota axis at the center of healthy aging
summary: Liver-associated diseases are highly relevant to aging people. Many factors have an effect on the health of the liver. In addition to infectious diseases, alcohol consumption and nutrition, the gut microbiota (the totality of microorganisms in the intestine) plays an important role. This study aims to investigate how the microbiota affects liver disease in aging people and over a longer period of time. With the help of this information, we want to better understand the relationships in order to be able to develop therapeutic approaches later.
conditions: Fatty (change of) liver, not elsewhere classified
Malignant neoplasm: Intrahepatic bile duct carcinoma
